games.description: Sark follows detective Derek into a haunted mansion, searches for event triggers, and gets stuck trying to find the next step. The session closes with the discovery of an easily missed button.
games.title: CONFUSION

games.description: Solo wave runs built around escalating turret upgrades, persistent unlocks and Big Joe’s chicken helicopter. A later return tests a patch released during the same broadcast.
games.title: KunKun Defender

games.description: Sark runs out of fuel, enters the cursed village and experiments with a violent escape route. After stealing a car and restarting, he finds a shortcut and races through a two-minute-forty-eight-second run.
games.title: MidNight Cemetery

games.description: Sark investigates a roadside killing, loses his first attempt to a passing car and starts again. Town clues lead to a cabin and an armed encounter with the mimic.
games.title: Mimic Search

games.description: Sark repairs a stranded tractor and follows a radio signal in the 2024 horror game. A restart, strange conversation and lamp preparations lead to a death that kicks him back to the desktop.
games.title: Mist

games.description: Sark manages flashlight power and trail cameras while the Widow of the Woods approaches. Repeated night attempts test battery use and calls, leading to case-closed screens and more retries.
games.title: Night at the Cabin

games.description: Sark works around a broken Steam launch path, then searches a black-and-white maze for eight books. Awkward controls and slow movement end the attempt after two pages.
games.title: Sad Satan

games.description: Sark drives toward a funeral, tangles with the car physics and explores a broken village house until the locked closet and dead flashlight halt progress.
games.title: Unholy Village
